previous_assumption: Wrapping an already-ColumnType timestamp field inside Kysely's Generated<...> helper (Generated<ColumnType<Date,...>>) correctly unwraps to Date on select.
correction: Nesting Generated<ColumnType<...>> produces a doubly-wrapped ColumnType that Kysely does not flatten, breaking every port interface that declared created_at as Date|string. Each such column needs one single ColumnType<SelectType, InsertType, UpdateType>, never Generated wrapping an existing ColumnType.
